title: DriveDiet: Cloud Storage Cleaner
context: Cloud drives fill up with duplicates and forgotten folders. A cleaner finds what to delete and how to sync efficiently.
input: Folder tree; file sizes and hashes; two devices’ listings; paths.

milestones.title: Duplicate files
milestones.requirement: Files with the same content hash.

milestones.title: Folder sizes
milestones.requirement: Post-order recursion for every folder’s total size.

milestones.title: Merge device listings
milestones.requirement: Merge two name-sorted file listings in one pass.

milestones.title: Find a name pattern
milestones.requirement: Count occurrences of a pattern in the concatenated path list (KMP).

milestones.title: Sync bandwidth
milestones.requirement: Minimum upload capacity per hour so files, in order, sync within 4 hours.

milestones.title: Thumbnail cache
milestones.requirement: LRU cache of thumbnails; hit ratio.
